rationale: Wind damage to the policyholder's own roof structure (shingles blown off the back porch overhang) is a classic property damage claim with no ambiguity.
claim_summary: Policyholder Jordan Lee (POL-1006) reports wind damage last weekend that blew approximately four shingles off the overhang above the back porch. No interior leaking or additional damage was reported. Estimated repair cost is $400 — note this is below the $2,500 deductible, so the claim will likely not result in a payout; adjuster should confirm with policyholder before proceeding.

case_facts.incident_cause: Wind blew approximately four shingles off the overhang above the back porch
case_facts.description: Four shingles blown off; no interior leaking, no additional damage reported
